toefl:se:127.answer: As Paul mentioned, realizing that we share similar issues can help us feel more connected and less alone.
toefl:se:127.fullSentence: As Paul mentioned, realizing that we share similar issues can help us feel more connected and less alone.
keyPhrases: feel more connected and less alone
toefl:se:127.japanese: ポールが述べたように、同じような悩みを共有していると気づくことは、私たちがより繋がりを感じ、より孤独を感じにくくなる助けになります。
toefl:se:127.explanation: realizing that〜は動名詞句が主語になる構造。
toefl:se:127.relatedInfo: feel a sense of solidarity / feel understood

toefl:se:128.answer: While sharing experiences is important, opening up about our problems really shows how much we care and support each other.
toefl:se:128.fullSentence: While sharing experiences is important, opening up about our problems really shows how much we care and support each other.
keyPhrases: how much we care and support
toefl:se:128.japanese: 経験を共有することも大切ですが、自分の問題について打ち明けることは、私たちがどれほど互いを気にかけ支え合っているかを本当に示します。
toefl:se:128.explanation: open up aboutで「〜について打ち明ける」を表す。
toefl:se:128.relatedInfo: reveal how much we care / demonstrate mutual support

toefl:se:129.answer: For these reasons, I believe that discussing problems is the best way to build stronger friendships.
toefl:se:129.fullSentence: For these reasons, I believe that discussing problems is the best way to build stronger friendships.
toefl:se:129.japanese: これらの理由から、問題を話し合うことがより強い友情を築く最良の方法だと私は考えます。
toefl:se:129.explanation: build a friendshipで「友情を築く」という定型表現。
toefl:se:129.relatedInfo: forge stronger friendships / cultivate deeper friendships

toefl:se:130.answer: I strongly believe teachers should assign seats in primary school classrooms.
toefl:se:130.fullSentence: I strongly believe teachers should assign seats in primary school classrooms.
toefl:se:130.japanese: 小学校の教室では教師が席を決めるべきだと私は強く思います。
toefl:se:130.explanation: assign seatsで「席を割り当てる」という表現。
toefl:se:130.relatedInfo: decide seating arrangements / determine where students sit

toefl:se:131.answer: At that age, children are still learning how to manage their behavior and attention, so they benefit from a structured environment.
toefl:se:131.fullSentence: At that age, children are still learning how to manage their behavior and attention, so they benefit from a structured environment.
toefl:se:131.japanese: その年齢の子どもたちはまだ自分の行動や注意力を管理する方法を学んでいる最中なので、構造化された環境から恩恵を受けます。
toefl:se:131.explanation: benefit fromで「〜から恩恵を受ける」を表す。
toefl:se:131.relatedInfo: thrive with clear structure / need guided routines

toefl:se:132.answer: First, as Kelly mentions, teachers can create combinations that support learning.
toefl:se:132.fullSentence: First, as Kelly mentions, teachers can create combinations that support learning.
toefl:se:132.japanese: まず、ケリーが述べるように、教師は学習を助ける組み合わせを作ることができます。
toefl:se:132.explanation: that以下はcombinationsを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:132.relatedInfo: pair students strategically / create effective groupings

toefl:se:133.answer: For example, a student who is shy but hardworking can sit next to a more talkative classmate who is good at explaining ideas.
toefl:se:133.fullSentence: For example, a student who is shy but hardworking can sit next to a more talkative classmate who is good at explaining ideas.
toefl:se:133.japanese: 例えば、内気だが努力家の生徒を、考えを説明するのが得意なよりおしゃべりなクラスメートの隣に座らせることができます。
toefl:se:133.explanation: who is good at explaining ideasはclassmateを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:133.relatedInfo: pair complementary strengths / sit beside a more outgoing peer

toefl:se:134.answer: This kind of pairing encourages cooperation and helps students learn from one another instead of always turning to the teacher.
toefl:se:134.fullSentence: This kind of pairing encourages cooperation and helps students learn from one another instead of always turning to the teacher.
keyPhrases: instead of always turning to the teacher
toefl:se:134.japanese: この種の組み合わせは協力を促し、生徒がいつも教師に頼るのではなく、互いから学び合う助けになります。
toefl:se:134.explanation: turn toで「〜に頼る」という表現。
toefl:se:134.relatedInfo: foster peer learning / rely on classmates instead of the teacher

toefl:se:135.answer: Second, seating plans can reduce distractions and ensure fairness.
toefl:se:135.fullSentence: Second, seating plans can reduce distractions and ensure fairness.
toefl:se:135.japanese: 第二に、座席計画は気を散らす要因を減らし、公平性を確保できます。
toefl:se:135.explanation: ensure〜で「〜を確実にする」を表す。

toefl:se:136.answer: If students choose their own seats, many will sit only with close friends, which can lead to constant chatting and leave quieter children isolated at the back.
toefl:se:136.fullSentence: If students choose their own seats, many will sit only with close friends, which can lead to constant chatting and leave quieter children isolated at the back.
toefl:se:136.japanese: もし生徒が自分で席を選ぶと、多くは親しい友人としか座らず、それが絶え間ないおしゃべりにつながり、大人しい子どもたちを後ろの席に孤立させる可能性があります。
toefl:se:136.explanation: leave A Bで「AをBの状態のままにする」を表す。
toefl:se:136.relatedInfo: cluster with close friends only / leave shy students on their own

toefl:se:137.answer: When the teacher assigns seats, every child has a chance to sit where they can see and hear well.
toefl:se:137.fullSentence: When the teacher assigns seats, every child has a chance to sit where they can see and hear well.
toefl:se:137.japanese: 教師が席を割り当てると、すべての子どもがよく見えよく聞こえる場所に座る機会を得られます。
toefl:se:137.explanation: where以下は場所を表す関係副詞節。
toefl:se:137.relatedInfo: get a fair seat / have equal access to the front

toefl:se:138.answer: Andrew is right that teachers might not always understand every social conflict.
toefl:se:138.fullSentence: Andrew is right that teachers might not always understand every social conflict.
toefl:se:138.japanese: 教師が常にすべての人間関係の対立を理解しているとは限らないというアンドリューの指摘は正しいです。
toefl:se:138.explanation: might not always doで「必ずしも〜するとは限らない」を表す。
toefl:se:138.relatedInfo: be unaware of / miss underlying tensions

toefl:se:139.answer: However, a good teacher can observe the class and adjust the seating chart when problems appear.
toefl:se:139.fullSentence: However, a good teacher can observe the class and adjust the seating chart when problems appear.
toefl:se:139.japanese: しかし、優れた教師はクラスを観察し、問題が現れたときに座席表を調整することができます。
toefl:se:139.explanation: whenは「〜する時」という時を表す接続詞。
toefl:se:139.relatedInfo: keep a close eye on the class / rearrange seats as needed

toefl:se:140.answer: Overall, assigned seats give the teacher a powerful tool to manage both learning and behavior effectively.
toefl:se:140.fullSentence: Overall, assigned seats give the teacher a powerful tool to manage both learning and behavior effectively.
toefl:se:140.japanese: 全体として、割り当てられた座席は、学習と行動の両方を効果的に管理するための強力な手段を教師に与えます。
toefl:se:140.explanation: give 人 物で「人に物を与える」という第4文型。
toefl:se:140.relatedInfo: provide an effective classroom management tool / offer a valuable means of control

toefl:se:141.answer: In my opinion, teachers should assign students' seats instead of letting students choose for themselves.
toefl:se:141.fullSentence: In my opinion, teachers should assign students' seats instead of letting students choose for themselves.
toefl:se:141.japanese: 私の意見では、生徒に自分で選ばせるのではなく、教師が生徒の席を割り当てるべきです。
toefl:se:141.explanation: instead of -ingで「〜する代わりに」を表す。
toefl:se:141.relatedInfo: decide seating for students / take charge of seating

toefl:se:142.answer: First, this helps children interact with different classmates, not just their close friends, which can improve their social skills.
toefl:se:142.fullSentence: First, this helps children interact with different classmates, not just their close friends, which can improve their social skills.
toefl:se:142.japanese: まず、これは子どもたちが親しい友人だけでなく異なるクラスメートと交流する助けになり、社会性を向上させることができます。
toefl:se:142.explanation: not just〜で「〜だけでなく」と限定を否定している。
toefl:se:142.relatedInfo: broaden social interactions / build wider friendships

toefl:se:143.answer: If students always sit with the same friends, they might not get to know others in the class.
toefl:se:143.fullSentence: If students always sit with the same friends, they might not get to know others in the class.
keyPhrases: always sit with the same friends
might not get to know others
toefl:se:143.japanese: もし生徒がいつも同じ友人と座っていたら、クラスの他の人たちを知る機会を持てないかもしれません。
toefl:se:143.explanation: get to know〜で「〜を知るようになる」を表す。
toefl:se:143.relatedInfo: stick with the same group / miss out on meeting others

toefl:se:144.answer: Also, teachers can arrange seats to mix students with different strengths so they can learn from each other and work together.
toefl:se:144.fullSentence: Also, teachers can arrange seats to mix students with different strengths so they can learn from each other and work together.
keyPhrases: learn from each other and work together
toefl:se:144.japanese: また、教師は異なる強みを持つ生徒を混ぜて座らせることで、互いに学び合い協力できるようにすることができます。
toefl:se:144.relatedInfo: combine different skill sets / encourage collaboration

toefl:se:145.answer: Additionally, assigning seats can help prevent conflicts and distractions that might happen if friends only sit together.
toefl:se:145.fullSentence: Additionally, assigning seats can help prevent conflicts and distractions that might happen if friends only sit together.
toefl:se:145.japanese: さらに、席を割り当てることは、友人同士だけで座った場合に起こりうる対立や気の散る要因を防ぐ助けになります。
toefl:se:145.explanation: that以下はconflicts and distractionsを修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:145.relatedInfo: reduce friction between students / avoid clique-like grouping

toefl:se:146.answer: Therefore, teacher-assigned seating is better for promoting learning and classroom harmony.
toefl:se:146.fullSentence: Therefore, teacher-assigned seating is better for promoting learning and classroom harmony.
toefl:se:146.japanese: したがって、教師が割り当てる座席の方が、学習とクラスの調和を促進するのに適しています。
toefl:se:146.explanation: be better for -ingで「〜するのに適している」を表す。
toefl:se:146.relatedInfo: support classroom harmony / foster a positive learning environment

toefl:se:147.answer: In my view, practical experience and learning from classes and books are equally important, but they serve different purposes in education.
toefl:se:147.fullSentence: In my view, practical experience and learning from classes and books are equally important, but they serve different purposes in education.
toefl:se:147.japanese: 私の考えでは、実践経験と授業や本からの学習は同じくらい重要ですが、教育において異なる目的を果たします。
toefl:se:147.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:147.explanation: serve a purposeで「目的を果たす」という表現。
toefl:se:147.relatedInfo: play different roles / fulfill different functions
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:148.answer: On the one hand, I agree with Kelly that modern society is too complex to rely only on observation or trial and error.
toefl:se:148.fullSentence: On the one hand, I agree with Kelly that modern society is too complex to rely only on observation or trial and error.
keyPhrases: too complex to rely only on
toefl:se:148.japanese: 一方で、現代社会は観察や試行錯誤だけに頼るには複雑すぎるというケリーの意見に賛成です。
toefl:se:148.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:148.explanation: too〜to doで「〜すぎて…できない」を表す。
toefl:se:148.relatedInfo: too complicated to learn by trial and error / beyond simple observation
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:149.answer: Professions like medicine, engineering, or law require a deep theoretical foundation, because people need solid knowledge before working safely with patients, machines, or legal cases.
toefl:se:149.fullSentence: Professions like medicine, engineering, or law require a deep theoretical foundation, because people need solid knowledge before working safely with patients, machines, or legal cases.
toefl:se:149.japanese: 医学や工学、法律のような職業は深い理論的基盤を必要とします。なぜなら、人々は患者や機械、法的案件を安全に扱う前に確かな知識を必要とするからです。
toefl:se:149.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:149.explanation: beforeは「〜する前に」と時の前後関係を示す。
toefl:se:149.relatedInfo: a solid theoretical base / a strong academic grounding
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:150.answer: Books and lectures organize decades of research in a way that would be impossible to gain just by "doing the job."
toefl:se:150.fullSentence: Books and lectures organize decades of research in a way that would be impossible to gain just by "doing the job."
toefl:se:150.japanese: 本や講義は、単に「実際に仕事をする」だけでは得られないような形で、何十年もの研究成果を体系化しています。
toefl:se:150.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:150.explanation: in a way that〜は「〜するような形で」という様態を示す。
toefl:se:150.relatedInfo: consolidate years of findings / systematize accumulated knowledge
src: 実際の経験と本の勉強1

toefl:se:151.answer: On the other hand, I also agree with Andrew that some skills simply cannot be mastered without hands-on practice.
toefl:se:151.fullSentence: On the other hand, I also agree with Andrew that some skills simply cannot be mastered without hands-on practice.
keyPhrases: cannot be mastered without hands-on practice
toefl:se:151.japanese: 他方で、実地の練習なしには習得できないスキルもあるというアンドリューの意見にも賛成です。
toefl:se:151.topic: 実際の経験と本の勉強
toefl:se:151.explanation: cannot be mastered withoutで「〜なしには習得できない」を表す。
toefl:se:151.relatedInfo: require real practice to learn / can only be learned by doing
